0022600106.text: The Milwaukee Bucks, who are 0-2 and 13th in the East, visit a Philadelphia 76ers team that is 2-0 and 1st in the Atlantic Division. The 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), while Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost 0-4, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12.
